title: FeaturePlanCommand
responsibility: Register a CLI for inspecting, selecting and approving feature plans.

inputs.name: constructor.dependencies
inputs.description: Tests inject structural collaborators; defaults are real feature plan repository, validator and readiness adapter.

inputs.name: plan commands
inputs.description: All commands support --json. Human output includes design choices, selection, module tree and wanted contracts.

inputs.name: constructor.dependencies.server
inputs.description: Defaults to the real server; an injected collaborator must provide runApproved for worker dispatch.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Without --worker, retry task submission. With --worker, run a single bounded batch scoped to the exact approved feature plan; parallelism defaults to one and requires a worker.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Read the exact page option from the latest plan matching the reviewed digest and save its verified committed image to a new file.

inputs.name: impact
inputs.description: Discover page impacts of a source-bound proposal from committed module relationships before designs are generated.

outputs.name: register
outputs.description: Registers the plan draft, show, select and approve child commands. Human output shows options, selection, preferred option, parent module tree and wanted contracts; --json emits structured plans.

outputs.name: approve
outputs.description: After approval, submit exactly the approved task records before reporting success. Tasks are queued; provider execution remains separately gated.

outputs.name: start
outputs.description: Without --worker, idempotently submit an approved plan. With --worker, await and report the approval-scoped server batch, including actual worker outcomes. A returned failed worker outcome sets the CLI process exit code to 1 after the actual outcome is printed.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Uses the revision- and option-bound planning image reader and prints the destination only after a successful write; never starts a provider.

outputs.name: impact
outputs.description: Print affected pages and graph blockers; invalid impact sets a nonzero CLI exit code. No provider is started.

errors.name: invalid command or plan
errors.description: Missing plan, malformed JSON, invalid selection, stale digest and readiness failures propagate without claiming success.

errors.name: submission failure
errors.description: Propagates without success output; an already committed approval remains available for start retry.

errors.name: invalid or unavailable worker dispatch
errors.description: Reject parallelism without a worker, non-integer or out-of-range parallelism, unavailable scoped dispatch, or server failures without printing a successful result.

errors.name: invalid plan image
errors.description: Missing plan, stale digest, unknown page or option, invalid image, existing output or filesystem failures reject without a success message.
